newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: Car rental group Avis lists in Botswana.
newsitem.headline: Car rental group Avis lists in Botswana.

text.p: Car rental and fleet management group Avis listed on the Botswana Stock Exchange(BSE) on Wednesday.

Avis Holdings listed 137,525,600 shares, opening at 5.89 pula. The first trade, a parcel of 500 shares, was done within seconds of Avis group chief executive Glenn van Heerden ringing the exchange bell.
Avis is also listed on the Johannesburg and Namibian stock exchanges.
The group has car rental operations in Botswana, Namibia, Swaziland, Angola, Lesotho, Madagascar, Malawi, Mozambique, Zambia and Zimbabwe.
There are fleet service operations in Botswana, Namibia, Mozambique and Zimbabwe.
The group sold 1.5 million car rental days in 1996 -- 38 percent of the southern African market -- and is forecasting growth to 2.1 million days by 2000 and a market share of 40 percent.
Wednesday's listing on the Botswana bourse was the fourth on the BSE this year. De Beers, Regent Undervalued Assets Africa Fund and McCarthy Retail listed earlier.
Johannesburg Stock Exchange-listed insurance group Forbes will list 215,145,200 shares in Botswana on June 21, a BSE official said.
